newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan PM bans imports of luxury goods.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan PM bans imports of luxury goods.

text.p: Pakistan's new Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif on Tuesday ordered a ban on the import of luxury goods to save hard foreign currency, the official APP news agency said.

It said Sharif, who took office on September 17 but has yet to name a cabinet, had told the chairman of the government's Central Board of Revenue to impose the ban on the import of "all luxury items except those required for industrial use".
It did not specify which items would be affected by the ban and quoted Sharif's order as saying that a detailed list must be prepared within a week.
"The prime minister, however, said care must be taken to exclude those items which are essential for use in industry," APP said.
Sharif's order came two days after he announced austerity plans for his government to reduce the country's foreign debt and urged overseas Pakistanis to open hard currency bank accounts at home.
